text: NetApp, Inc. is a Delaware corporation listed on Nasdaq (NTAP); per its 2026 proxy statement, its largest disclosed shareholders are BlackRock, Inc. (9.87%), two Vanguard entities (7.34% and 6.48%) and State Street Corporation (5.24%). No state or sovereign-fund holder is listed among them.

source.name: NetApp, Inc., 2026 Proxy Statement (DEF 14A)
source.quote: each person or entity who is known by the Company to own beneficially more than 5% of the Company's common stock
